results.name: reducer 'reconcile': the newer desktop's shared data wins, this tab keeps exactly its own windows/focus, z order stays monotonic, revision never goes back
a fresh tab hydrates at the row revision even when the stored state JSON lacks one, so its first save is accepted (no 409)
another tab saves a newer desktop → this tab's stale save gets 409 → it adopts the newer desktop, says so, and its next save builds on it (nothing lost on either side)
